title: Agreements and Classes Covered by Each Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan
content:
A Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan covers one rental agreement. Which agreements a plan can cover depends on the plan: the kind of agreement, the class of the unit or space, how long the agreement has run, and the agreement's standing when the plan is bought.

## Kinds of agreement and minimum tenure

| Plan | Storage unit rental agreement | Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement | Calendar months the agreement must have run before purchase |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Yes | Yes | 0 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Yes | Yes | 0 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Yes | Yes | 1 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | Yes | No | 3 |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | Yes | No | 3 |

## Classes each plan can cover

A mark means the class is on the plan's list; a dash means it is not.

| Unit or space class | 3-Month | 6-Month | 9-Month | 12-Month | 18-Month | 24-Month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Drive-Up Standard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – |
| Bluegate Interior Standard | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – |
| Bluegate Climate Controlled | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Bluegate Climate Plus | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Bluegate Premier Climate Suite | – | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault | – | – | – | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | ✓ | ✓ | – | – | – | – |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | – | – |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | ✓ | ✓ | – | ✓ | – | – |

## Standing of the agreement at purchase

The same standing applies under all six plans:

| Condition at purchase | 3-Month | 6-Month | 9-Month | 12-Month | 18-Month | 24-Month |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agreement status must be active | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Agreement must owe nothing (balance due no more than $0.00) | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A pending move-out notice prevents purchase | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| A delinquent or lien-stage agreement may not buy a plan | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Plans in pending payment or active status allowed on one agreement | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

## Reading the tables (hypothetical agreements)

- A Bluegate Wine & Collectibles Vault unit agreement appears only under the 12-, 18- and 24-month plans; under the 18- and 24-month plans it must also have run at least 3 calendar months, and under the 12-month plan at least 1.
- A Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) parking agreement appears only under the 3- and 6-month plans, which require no minimum tenure.
- A Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage agreement is listed for the 3-, 6- and 12-month plans and not for the 9-month plan.
- A parking agreement of any class is outside the 18- and 24-month plans, which cover storage unit rental agreements only.
- An agreement that has run 2 calendar months meets the tenure of the 3- through 12-month plans and not that of the 18- and 24-month plans.
